notes.decision: Translated 'the Mother of Life' — standard Manichaean cosmological figure (consort/companion of First Man). The collocation ⲙⲉⲩ + ⲡⲱⲛⲍ is the technical title.

Tentatively analyzed as ⲁϥ-ϫⲱⲕ-ⲥ̄ 'he perfected/completed her' (Lyc. ⲭ for ϫ; ϫⲱⲕ 'fulfill, perfect' + 3sg.f suffix). Parallel verb ⲁϩⲕⲁⲁⲥ ('he set her') in same line supports a verb-of-establishment reading.
ⲧⲱⲍⲙⲉ = Lyc. ⲧⲱϩⲙ̄ 'call forth, summon' — the technical Manichaean verb of serial emanation (cf. accumulated vocab). The Five Sons are 'called forth' from the First Man.
Parsed as ⲭⲉ (= ϫⲉ 'that') + ⲉⲩⲛⲁ-ⲣ̄ⲡⲣⲟ 'they will reign' (future III, Lyc. ⲡⲡⲣⲟ for ⲣ̄ⲣⲟ via assimilation). The reduplication ⲡ̄ⲡ̄ is a scribal feature of Lycopolitan.
ⲍⲁⲕϩ̄ = ϩⲱⲕ 'strip' + suffix (cf. ⲁϩϩⲱⲕ in accumulated vocab); ⲙⲁⲣϩ̄ = ⲙⲟⲩⲣ 'bind' + suffix. Twin-verb sequence 'stripped him, bound him' fits the cosmological-mythic register of capture.
Translated 'the Stillness' per accumulated vocabulary — Manichaean technical term, also a name of the Fast.
Greek φορεῖν 'to wear, bear' — First Man wears his Five Sons as armor before descending into battle. Standard Manichaean cosmogonic detail (cf. five storehouses/garments = Five Light Elements).
ⲧⲱϩ = 'mingling, joining' (cf. ⲧⲱⲍⲙ in vocab); with ⲙⲉⲑⲟⲣⲓⲟⲛ 'boundary' yields 'a joining of boundaries' — the cosmological line where the regions meet.

ⲉⲥⲕⲉ likely Lyc. infinitive of ⲱⲥⲕ 'tarry, delay, prolong (time)'. ⲣ̄- + noun = 'spend a tarrying' = 'tarried, lingered.' The pairing ⲣ̄ ⲟⲩⲕⲁⲓⲣⲟⲥ ⲙⲛ ⲟⲩⲭⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ ('spent a season and a time') in lines 18-19 frames the same kind of temporal-extension idiom.

ⲧⲃⲁⲧ tentatively rendered 'cubit' (a measure-noun); ϣⲓ = 'measure'. The phrase 'number of cubits of the measure of those who mount upon them' fits a cosmological accounting of the wind/breath-vehicles' span.
ⲛⲓϩ = 'breath, wind' (Sah. ⲛⲓϥⲉ). The breaths/winds that come down into the cosmos are the cosmological wind-element vehicles.

ⲧⲱⲟⲩ 'mountain' + relative clause 'of those who serve/praise.' ϣⲉⲩⲉ tentatively rendered 'serve' (cf. ϣⲙϣⲉ 'serve, worship'). The First Man stands on a 'mountain of those who serve' until the descent to combat.

ⲡⲁⲡⲉⲁⲩ 'the glorious one' (per vocab); ⲥⲛⲏⲩⲧ qualitative of ⲥⲛⲏⲩⲧⲉ 'flow forth, emanate.' Construction: 'the gods of the glorious one who are emanated' — the gods belonging to the Father of Greatness who flow forth from him.

Greek ζωγραφέω 'paint, depict from life' — the cosmogonic verb whereby the Father of Greatness 'depicts' (calls into manifest cosmic form) each emanation. Same verb earlier used of Matter painting herself; here used of Light's positive depiction. Preserves the iconic-creative semantics.
